# Playbook Contract

Every playbook in references/ follows this section layout.

Sections in order: Trigger, Intent, Workflow, Output, Boundaries.

Trigger lists the vocabulary tokens that select this playbook.

Workflow steps are numbered and each one is independently checkable.

Boundaries state what the playbook must never do.

Playbooks stay under thirty lines to remain readable in one pass.

A playbook not linked from SKILL.md is unreachable and flagged.
